title: Cost/latency tradeoff slider in canary rollback flow
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Summary: Design an inline 'cost vs latency' tradeoff slider embedded directly in the canary rollback/adjustment flow for Private (VPC) clusters. The control should let an operator tune a deployment's safety/efficiency point (e.g., pick a quantized model variant, batching aggressiveness, and KV cache policy) and immediately preview estimated per-token cost and p95 latency impact across the canary window. Rationale: On private deployments customers need to weigh cost units (reserved GPU/minutes, regional egress) against strict latency SLOs before applying rollbacks or policy changes. Currently operators must navigate separate cost dashboards and run manual simulations. Goal: reduce cognitive overhead and decrease time to safe rollback decisions for on-call and SRE teams.

Design constraints and assumptions: works in Private and Dedicated modes; must surface only options permitted by RBAC and tenant-specific quantization/variant policies; backend will provide a cost-profile API (ENG-20123) and a latency profile service (ENG-20789) that return estimates for selected model/sequence-length distributions. Non-goals: full cost forecasting across multiple tenants; replacing the full cost explorer.

Proposed UX: within the existing canary rollback drawer add a compact horizontal slider with three anchored presets: Conservative (favor latency), Balanced, and Aggressive (favor cost). The slider updates two small KPI chips in real-time: Estimated cost delta (USD/hour or RU/min) and Expected p95 latency (ms). Hovering the chips opens tooltip micro-summaries with simulation assumptions (seq length percentile, batch size). An optional 'Simulate' toggle will run a short sandboxed evaluation (10s) showing a sparkline of latency variance and a confidence band for the estimator.

Accessibility: keyboard focusable, clear labels, colorblind-safe palette for the slider states, ARIA descriptions for the simulation toggle and KPI chips.

Deliverables: Figma prototype with interactive slider states, annotated spec for engineering (API surface and error states), copy for micro-tooltips, and QA checklist.

Links: Figma mockups: https://www.figma.com/file/abcd1234/console-cost-latency-slider (see frames: Canary-Drawer-Slider, Simulation-Preview); prototype video: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1Xyz/view; design PRD draft: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1design-prd
acceptance_criteria: Slider present in canary rollback drawer for Private and Dedicated clusters when user has rollout adjust permissions
Three anchored presets and freeform adjustment available; adjusting updates KPIs within 200ms of interaction
KPI chips display cost delta and expected p95 latency with tooltip explanation of assumptions
Simulate toggle triggers a sandbox evaluation and shows a sparkline or clear error if simulation not permitted
Design includes responsive layout for narrow consoles and passes a11y keyboard/contrast checks
Engineering spec lists required backend endpoints and error handling patterns
comments: 2026-03-03 Maya Chen: Initial kickoff meeting with PM and Eng. PM (Ethan Rivera) confirmed ENG-20123 (cost API) is available in v1; latency estimator will be a best-effort until ENG-20789 lands.
2026-03-04 Luca Martins: Wireframes created for Conservative/Balanced/Aggressive states. Shared on Figma. Requested microcopy from Content (Anika Patel) for tooltip language.
2026-03-05 Pedro Alvarez (Eng): Raised backend concern - current cost API returns hourly RU only; need conversion helpers for per-minute and token-based dashboards. Marking dependency ENG-20123.

2026-03-06 Design review: PM flagged that RBAC hides certain model variants; design updated to gray-out unavailable variants and show reason on hover. Decision: keep slider presets but restrict suggested actions when policy blocks change.

2026-03-07 UX review notes (Design Lead - Satoshi Ito): prefer a single KPI row with inline legend rather than two separate chips to save vertical space in narrow consoles. Action: produce an alternate compact layout for testing.
2026-03-07 QA handoff: include test steps for simulation timeout and error banner copy; ENG to notify when latency estimator has 95% CI support.
